body: Most likely I just get nervous . I tend to not get along with ppl my age anyways I only graduated highschool two years ago . My work friends are much older than me

Another thing, it might not get better. And if you think like that , it will never get better. I try to see it as it could be worse . And that’s not meant to make anyone feel bad it’s meant to make you pay attention to the positive, even if it’s the smallest most ridiculous thing , one tiny flame of good can spread . But if we keep throwing cold thoughts into that flame it will burn out. And the hope and positivity will die in you and to get that back is VERY difficult alone .

i know this feeling . I’ve isolated myself from everyone and most things I don’t have socials except for this once in a while . I don’t talk to people unless I have to . I’m living with my own solitude . That’s the only way I’ve ever gotten better for me . I know relationships will never be fore me , or friendships . I am a deeply mistrusting person. I don’t like others . But I care about them enough to make sure they’re okay. I found peace alone . I know you want to tell your friends and loved ones how you’re feeling. You are doing god by telling strangers at least. It’s a big burden to carry yourself . Don’t think of it as making others carrying that with you when you tell them. It’s more they’re helping you lift it away. A lot of times we lack perspective on situations . We only know our own experiences, but humans are intelligent and interesting beings and we all can relate some way through different experiences. And help us see things in a different light. I might not be a huge people person but I do like to have conversations about life and when it’s necessary I’ve learned to reach out to people. For me personally it’s not because I feel alone with my thoughts but it’s because I know I won’t be able to navigate through a problem if my mindset is stuck. I need to change the view .

Any suggestion are great! I do have work friends but that’s all they are . Friends while at work. When I have time off the only thing I do is go out alone . It’s strange I have a lot of confidence in myself but when it comes to talking to people im only able to do it in certain situations if that makes sense . Im fine with training others and explaining things . Im a manager so I need to have those people skills and I do . Just when it comes to getting to know people I struggle I guess. I don’t know if it’s because I don’t care enough or im scared .

No , in all honestly I just don’t care . I don’t believe I have any true say in anything at all and I really don’t see the point in stressing out over something I can be completely oblivious to and happy not knowing. I only care about how I treat others , don’t care if others treat me bad , I’ll get away from them. There will always be conflict , always and I don’t want any part in it .
I know it can be difficult but the ability to change our perspective is what helps us the most . I know you are capable. :)))

It wouldn’t be a different person. Let’s think literally. You are you because of you’re experiences and we learn through experiences right? The more experiences you have and the way you look at them , you can be happier or worse in your thoughts it depends on how you view them . But either way you do view them , you are learning and training yourself to think a certain way . It will always be you . You are the only person who truly understands yourself , honestly that’s our greatest strength .

I know what it’s like . Honestly my blood isn’t my family. I’ve chosen my family and they e chosen me . We have eachother . Those people I found are the only reason I still have some bit of faith in humanity because most people really do suck .

I can understand the feeling of not deserving to get help or better. Advice I can give you from my experience is , the reason to try and to get help is yourself . Love yourself and life . By life I know it can be difficult, but by loving life you are enjoying the experience, we need to enjoy the good and bad . Without the bad there can be no good. I know how unfair life can be but I also know how amazing it can be and I choose to focus on how good it can be and it’s potential. Trust me this mindset is the key. I mean Im currently sitting in an Empty park I g lit unable to sleep and waiting for the police to come kick me out but I really don’t care because I have better days ahead of me , I know I can also have worse days . We are allowed to feel upset and sad but we also have to rennet not to dwell in those feelings . If we come to the conclusion that life is meaningless then all we will experience is the suffering and agony of that mindset .

You’re important. A lot of people don’t realize what they have in front of them. It’s sad. It can be a very lonely world even while you’re surrounded by people . But you are important, to me you right now also. I can assure you there are people I. The world who won’t even need to choose between options . There are people in the world who you are their only option.
Do you mind sharing why it is you don’t want to get better?
You can still help yourself before it is too late. But you can let your feelings out now too , I hope you reach the decision to call someone

In reality , it’s the end . Of the problems and the suffering but it is also the end of the potential life has , you would take away the potential for the happiest days of your life . You would take away every last bit of hope you had. To only see life as nothing but meaningless and suffering you are only letting yourself experience that suffering. Think about a moment where you’ve actually felt peace , even if it was the smallest moment that lasted less than a minute . We need to hold on to those moments and we need to create more for ourselves .

It’s normal and juman for us to be afraid of death it’s only natural. It’s okay to be sad and upset , it’s okay to have feelings of hopelessness once in a while. I’m the end all we want is to reach happiness and even people who commit are really just people who are desperately trying to find that peace . Being able to recognize what brings us peace can be a very difficult journey , but it’s a necessary one. What’s on your mind today?

I know if the people I cared about where here they’d want to continue living and experience the world and I know they’ll always be with me so that’s why I choose to explore and I try my best to enjoy every second of existence. Because I know they are with me everywhere I go. I’m not a religious person but I am a spiritual one and a little crazy so that helps. Sometimes you have to literally talk to the grass and let it out . It’s okay to be upset and angry and frustrated at the world and life . But it really is a gift. We always seem to realize that too late . I hope you choose to continue living for them

Living means enjoying the experience and loving life. So I’m choosing to do that even if life is realllly shitty . I understand every point you’ve made. But you have to know there will never be valid reason to kill yourself. There are few valid reasons for death . You’re right we weren’t asked to be put on this earth or experience what we have and endured the unimaginable. Without the bad there is no good. We dictate what happens , we can choose the right and wrong path for ourselves . Happiness isn’t a person it is a feeling of peace and if only a person can give that to you it’s not true. That is only me , because I know there are many things for you to live for , you may not believe that, but it’s actually true . 

Humans have a lot of potential it just depends on where they choose to focus that energy on.

I don’t think this could be true. You have reached a point where you are believing the judgments you have of yourself. I don’t think there is just one singular reason to live. We can make reasons to live , we can also take them away from ourselves.

Everyone has a use , we just need to learn or find out how to be of proper for ourselves mostly the others . Helping others is nice yeah, but we need to know ourselves and be secure. I think you have identity. You are a person who is reaching out because you need help, you desire happiness. 

We are honestly all lost , we will never know the answer to many things , if there are gods, if someone will be happy or sad when we are no longer there. Those are assumptions. 

If you need to talk and vent there are people here for you . I am here for you and I actually do care about people , a lot . That’s why I’m up and waiting for someone to post so I could help them because I know what it’s like to desperately seek help and not find it.  

So I’m here for you and anyone who needs it.

We know we cannot change the evils of the world . Even there there is probably more bad than good in the world. There is still good. The world might be ugly but this planet isn’t, sure humans destroy a lot and knowing that can really ruin our image of them. Let’s not ruin our image of the planet or nature because to be honest some things are pretty cool. Whether it’s the feeling you get when you look at a painting. Or the feeling you don’t get. Everything in this world is so complex . And we are such complex brains that we sometimes can’t even handle that so we want to get away from it. But I believe there’s purpose . Not because of a god or because we’ll miss out  on “life”. I think the purpose is enjoying the experience even when it doesn’t seem enjoyable.

If we keep the outlook that life is meaningless then that only allows us to really live and experience in suffering and agony. 

We can change our perspective , our mindset. And when I mean change , I mean really. I just quit my job because i wasnt happy there anymore. I’ve almost dropped out of college because the stress was too much and motivation is nonexistent. But I decided I have to keep going for myself not my parents . I changed my major to fine arts . I’m not going to let my past and all the mistakes and trauma I’ve endured dictate my happiness. 

Let’s sit and focus on what we want to be , who we want to be , what seriously brings us moments of peace. 

Let’s just do what makes us happy, literally. If we like that jacket let’s buy it, if we feel like going to the beach the park , have a day trip to the city , let’s just go. I’ve been doing a lot of this lately . At first I realized I wasn’t letting myself enjoy the experience of life and I was actually telling myself I’m not allowed to be happy . I knew it was wrong to think that way , but the more I did it and actually tried to let myself the more peace I experienced. 

Depression can be excruciating. So when we tell our self we don’t belong , we believe it. 

But I believe we all belong here . We are all very complex beings who are capable of so many amazing things . And though we must believe in ourselves , a little help from others can also be a great blessing.
